items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: he would teach me, he would show me how to do this... I had a goodie at that time and then he would play it down and he'd show me how to play

ctx.x: Oh, let me see, 19. That was about nine years old. So you're nine years old and it was Percy Humphrey's.
What did Percy tell you? I mean, were the lessons he gave you then applicable to what you're playing now?
